free_text: The panel protocol concluded with no biopsy based on the identical precedent in the labelled series, which is supported by the laboratory result showing a PSA density of 0.053 ng/mL/mL meeting the low-risk threshold. Although the PSA trend was rising and the PI-RADS was 4, the low PSA density finding conflicts with the imaging and trend, leading to a deferral pending clarification on the documented prior biopsy grade and surveillance status.
